name: terrain
doc: A terrain (design/terrain.md): the ground of a playable region, built inside a shape whose sides are given (each an aspect: its edge, height, and rise) with entrances, exits, and water in and out on them, and flats kept level for a settlement planner. relief builds and plans it as hexbound columns of spans (design/import.hexbound.world.md): hills by the parameters, rivers carved from inlet to outlet, terraced rock and caves, roads joining every opening and flat graded on a navigation mesh, bridges with their mounts; mesh draws it by the hexbound rules. Its hull goes to a boundary so the world beyond starts where it ends, and its open land to a plotter.

params.name: shape
params.doc: The shape: its corners, each side's aspect, and its openings (config/terrain_shapes/). A game gives its own.

params.name: flat
params.doc: A flat kept level for a settlement planner, if any (a town is optional).

params.name: biome
params.doc: The biome: the colours (a boundary's, so the two match).

params.name: relief
params.doc: How high hills stand above the sides' blend.

params.name: ridges
params.doc: How much of the relief is ridged rather than rolling.

params.name: cliffs
params.doc: How much steep land is terraced rock.

params.name: caves
params.doc: How often cliffs open into cave mouths.

params.name: river_depth
params.doc: How deep rivers run below their banks.
